findings.text: the observation branch rewrites exit_status, failure_ids and completed but leaves the arm's delivered failure_count, so promotion_evidence._receipt_mismatches refuses the repaired arm against the very log it now cites: reproduced with the landed test's own fixture, a two-process log of 3 failures leaves failure_count 0 and _require_gate_log_agrees raises 'its failure_count records 0 and the log names 3 failed or errored test(s)', the same class of refusal this node exists to remove.

the landing case runs _zero_added_against_a_red_base and _require_verdict_matches_exit_status only, skipping _require_gate_log_agrees which promotion.py:1461 runs in the real promotion path and which refuses the same repaired arm, so the test's landing claim is narrower than the promotion it stands for.

the fragment and the manifest state the base arm ran on all_debug, but gate-s58.sh runs pytest directly in a /tmp scratch tree with no srun or sbatch and gate-base.log records no partition, so the partition named in the landing record is not evidence.
